headline: Heidelberg Materials India subsidiary files SEBI takeover disclosure for HeidelbergCement India Limited acquisition
sum: Heidelberg Materials South Asia B.V. filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), signalling a consolidation move within the HeidelbergCement India shareholder structure; the transaction triggers mandatory open-offer provisions under the Indian takeover code.
detail: Heidelberg Materials South Asia B.V., formerly known as Cementrum I BV, disclosed acquisition of shares in HeidelbergCement India Limited to the NSE via filing by signatories M.C.M. Cremers and I.M. Westerhof-Zwevernink. The disclosure is lodged under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, which requires acquirers crossing 25% shareholding thresholds to make public disclosures and typically triggers a mandatory open offer. The filing was submitted to the exchange on or around 15–16 June 2026. Specific transaction value, offer price, and final shareholding percentage are not extractable from the headline reference and require full PDF access.
